office_does: A Skagit County District Court judge hears misdemeanor and gross-misdemeanor criminal cases, traffic infractions, civil claims up to $100,000, small claims and protection orders; judges are elected countywide.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Judge Jenifer Howson is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Skagit County District Court judge since 2021 and former presiding judge; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: District Court judge since January 2021, court commissioner 2017-2020, presiding judge for four years [S1]
Led development of the county's Community Court network [S1]
Re-elected unopposed in 2022 with 98.4% of the vote [S5]
